headline.description: The single most important takeaway, max ~100 characters.

summary.description: 3-5 sentences in plain English: what is happening in the market and what the bot is doing about it.

stance.description: How much risk the bot should take right now. flat = stay in cash.

confidence.description: 0-100 confidence in this read of the market.

detail.description: One sentence with the specific numbers/expectations.

items.description: US-listed ticker in uppercase, e.g. NVDA. No exchange prefix, no $.

time_et.description: Scheduled time today as HH:MM ET, or null if not scheduled.

symbol.description: US-listed ticker in uppercase, e.g. NVDA. No exchange prefix, no $.

thesis.description: One sentence: why this name is in play today.

trigger.description: Concrete entry condition, e.g. 'holds above VWAP 412.50 after first pullback with SPY green'.

watchlist.description: 4-12 candidates for the rest of the session (not currently held).

symbol.description: The stock, or the option's UNDERLYING stock for option actions.

action.description: STOCKS: buy = open a NEW position (never add to one). sell = sell some or all of a held position. adjust_exits = replace a held position's stop-loss/take-profit. hold = keep a held position unchanged. OPTIONS: buy_option = open a new options position (needs `option`). close_option = close an open options position (needs structure_id). hold_option = keep it (needs structure_id; may tighten stop_loss/take_profit).

allocation_pct.description: Stock buy only: % of total account equity to commit (e.g. 8 means 8%). null otherwise.

sell_pct.description: Stock sell only: % of the currently held shares to sell, 1-100 (100 = close the position). null otherwise.

stop_loss.description: Stocks (buy, adjust_exits): stop-loss trigger in dollars, BELOW the current price. Options: the UNDERLYING price that proves the trade wrong (below the current price for calls and call spreads, above it for puts and put spreads); the position is closed when the stock crosses it. null = none.

take_profit.description: Stocks (buy, adjust_exits): take-profit limit in dollars, ABOVE the current price. Options: the UNDERLYING price at which to take profit (above for calls, below for puts). null = none.

horizon.description: intraday = flat by the close. overnight = may carry to tomorrow. multi_day = swing position (every options position is multi_day).

conviction.description: 1-10. Below the minimum in CONTEXT means do not open a trade.

rationale.description: 1-3 sentences: why this, why now. Cite specific numbers from CONTEXT or RESEARCH.

evidence.description: 2-5 concrete facts with numbers/times that support the decision.

invalidation.description: The specific price/event that proves the idea wrong.

structure_id.description: close_option / hold_option: the id of the position from OPEN OPTIONS POSITIONS. null otherwise.

strategy.description: long_call / long_put = buy one contract type. call_debit_spread = buy a call and sell a higher-strike call, same expiration. put_debit_spread = buy a put and sell a lower-strike put, same expiration.

long_leg.description: Contract to BUY, copied exactly from OPTION CHAINS, e.g. NVDA261120C00140000.

short_leg.description: Spreads only: the contract to SELL, copied exactly from OPTION CHAINS, same expiration as long_leg. null for long_call / long_put.

premium_pct.description: % of account equity to spend on premium (at most OPTIONS.max_premium_per_trade_pct).

stop_loss_pct.description: Exit when the position is worth this % less than was paid, e.g. 50. null = the default.

take_profit_pct.description: Take profit when the position is worth this % more than was paid, e.g. 100. null = the default.

option.description: buy_option only: what to buy, chosen from OPTION CHAINS. null for every other action.

decisions.description: Concrete orders for THIS cycle. Must include exactly one decision for every open stock position (hold / adjust_exits / sell) and every open options position (hold_option / close_option). Empty in premarket and postmarket.

risks.description: 2-5 risks to the portfolio right now.

lessons.description: Postmarket: 2-5 concrete, reusable lessons from today. Other phases: lessons being applied (may be empty).

next_focus.description: What to watch before the next cycle, with levels/times.
